senses.gloss: m. (חוּב, v. חַיָּיב) obligation; restriction, disadvantage; conviction.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 2b:7">Sabb. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>מהן לח׳ ומהן לפטור</he> some of them are mentioned for conviction (as punishable), and some as not punishable.
<cite ref="Shabbat 3a:4">Ib. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ חטאת</he> obligation to bring a sin-offering.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 9:1:4">Y. Keth. IX, beg. 32ᵈ</cite> <he>מזכותו אתה למד חִיּיוּבו</he> from his privilege you can deduct his restriction (what he has no right to).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 3:1:8">Y. Ḥall. III, beg. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>מפטור על ח׳</he> from what is exempt (from Ḥallah) for what is subject (to Ḥallah); a. fr.
